description: This file defines the EntityConditionSubSelect class, which implements a sub-query condition for entity queries in the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for generating SQL sub-select statements, managing internal state, and interacting with entity models.

classes.name: EntityConditionSubSelect
classes.description: Represents a sub-select condition used in entity queries, capable of generating SQL sub-query strings based on entity models and conditions.

methods.name: addSqlValue
methods.description: Generates the SQL string for the sub-select condition, including SELECT, FROM, and WHERE clauses based on the local entity and condition.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Creates an immutable copy of the current EntityConditionSubSelect instance.

methods.name: getKeyFieldName
methods.description: Returns the key field name used in the sub-select.

methods.name: getModelEntity
methods.description: Returns the ModelEntity associated with this sub-select.
